metadata.title: The Level and the Chalk
metadata.source: segmented from a Fabula-only package by gemini-3.8-flash

facts.statement: Winter storms eroded the lower chalk beds beneath The Redoubt causing the seaward footings to drop three inches.
Arthur Arkwright masked the sheared cellar foundation with treated timber wainscoting to conceal active coastal subsidence.
Arthur Arkwright signed a binding disclosure waiver admitting knowledge of ground subsidence and refusing structural underpinning.
The East Coast Marine Trust contracted Nicholas Vance to inspect The Redoubt under cover as a private cash buyer.
Nicholas Vance is bound under his institutional surveyor contract to publish a statutory condemnation notice on any structurally compromised listing.
Brenda Keel holds an overdue eighteen thousand pound commercial call note against Gallagher and Sons requiring immediate settlement.
The Portling tidal sluice gate automatically closes at four in the afternoon on storm warning days, cutting off road access to The Redoubt spit.
Nicholas Vance carries a calibrated brass crack width gauge concealed inside a vintage fountain pen casing.
The southern bay sash window of The Redoubt jams in its frame due to a two degree seaward tilt of the chalk footing.
The combination to the locked agency drawer containing the Arkwright disclosure waiver is nineteen forty-eight.

premise.logline: An estate agent falls for the one buyer who can see what is wrong with the house she is desperate to sell.

modules.theme: honesty as a thing that costs money
modules.setting_place: a seaside town where every other house is for sale
modules.protagonist: an estate agent one bad month from losing the agency
modules.protagonist_want: to close the sale without lying outright
modules.antagonism: her own need for the commission
modules.complication: the buyer is a surveyor pretending not to be one
modules.ending_shape: the sale falls through and the relationship does not

plot_shape.name: Courtship
plot_shape.central_question: What has to be given up for these two to be honest with each other?

phases.name: Two worlds
phases.purpose: Both parties established separately, each with a commitment in the way.

phases.name: Collision
phases.purpose: Forced proximity; a misjudgement each makes about the other.

phases.name: Concealment
phases.purpose: Something true is withheld, for a reason that is not cowardice.

phases.name: Exposure
phases.purpose: The withheld thing surfaces at the worst available moment.

phases.name: Terms
phases.purpose: What each actually gives up, stated plainly.

cast_roles.purpose: Withholds something, and has a good reason.
A person embodying what one of them owes elsewhere.
Knows the withheld thing and is bound not to say it.

obligatory_moves: The reader learns the withheld thing before the second party does.
The misjudgement is reasonable given what that character has been shown.
Neither party gets what they wanted without naming what it costs.
